title: Backup location (Google Drive)
help: Every video on YouTube is copied to your Google Drive under this folder, one folder per series. The host keeps a video's files until Drive has all of them.
failed: Could not complete the request. Try again.
conflict: Someone else changed these settings. Your edits are still here: reload the saved settings and review them before saving again.
readOnly: You can view the backup. Changing it or testing it requires settings management permission.
refreshed: Latest settings and status loaded. Your unsaved edits have been kept.
statusTitle: Is every uploaded video in Drive?
allDone: All {count} uploaded videos are completely backed up in {path}.
notAllDone: {left} of {count} uploaded videos are not completely backed up yet. The host keeps their files until they are.
offStatus: Backups are off: nothing is copied to Drive, and the host clears finished videos as before.
noneUploaded: No video is on YouTube yet.
showIncomplete: Show only those not backed up
enabled: Back up the videos on YouTube to Google Drive
pathHelp: Paste the folder from your PC (G:\我的雲端硬碟\AI\備份\) or its path in Drive (AI/備份).
pathInvalid: Use a folder in your Drive, without .. or the characters < > : " | ? *
lock: The host's rclone may write to {path} and the folders below it.
lockUnknown: The host has not reported its rclone folder yet.
tiersHelp: Dramas and animation ({categories}) keep their clips, keyframes and character sheets too (full); every other video keeps its upload package (basic). A series' folder is fixed once its first video is backed up.
newSeriesInvalid: A series key is lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
testPending: Test requested {time}; the worker answers in its next round (about five minutes). Reload to see the answer.
